title: Peek Settings
description: User settings for the Peek database GUI.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema file. Lets editors provide autocomplete and validation.

name.description: Display name used in multiplayer sessions. Defaults to the system $USER.

ai.description: AI configuration for the built-in agent and background features.

default_provider.description: Default backend for new Agent nodes (each node can switch). 'ollama' uses the ollama block below; 'acp' spawns an external Agent Client Protocol agent (e.g. Claude Code).

ollama.description: OpenAI/Ollama-compatible completion endpoint (local or remote). Backs the 'ollama' agent provider and background AI (query labels, region names). Omit this block to disable those features.

model.description: Model identifier passed to the endpoint.

url.description: Base URL of the OpenAI/Ollama-compatible server.

automatically_label_queries.description: When a query node is executed, ask the AI for a short label and show it as the node's title. Requires the ollama block.

acp.description: External ACP agent to spawn when provider is 'acp'. Defaults to the Claude Code adapter via npx. Best paired with mcp.enable so the agent can drive the canvas.

command.description: Executable that launches the ACP agent.

args.description: Arguments passed to the agent command.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the agent subprocess (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). The agent handles its own auth.

cwd.description: Session root handed to the agent. Defaults to Peek's config directory (~/peek).

mcp.description: Model Context Protocol server. Lets AI agents drive Peek. Takes effect on restart.

enable.description: Run the MCP server at startup.

port.description: Port the MCP server listens on (binds 0.0.0.0).

enable_regions.description: Region grouping and wayfinding on the canvas: zoom-out beacons, off-screen edge peekers and the regions menu.

minimap.description: Overview minimap in the bottom-right corner of the canvas: a colored rectangle per node plus the current viewport, draggable to pan.

show_as.description: How pages are surfaced in the titlebar: 'tabs' shows a horizontal tab strip; 'list' shows a single pill that opens a keyboard-navigable page list.

titlebar.description: Show or hide individual items in the titlebar. Hiding an item only removes it from the titlebar; the underlying feature still works (the command palette via its hotkey, live queries keep running, and the collaboration popover still opens from the command palette).

command_palette_button.description: Show or hide the command palette button in the titlebar.

collaboration_button.description: Show or hide the collaboration button in the titlebar.

live_query_count.description: Show or hide the live query count indicator in the titlebar.

workspaces.description: Workspaces shown in the connection picker. Each groups one or more database connections.

keymap.description: Keyboard shortcut overrides, mapping a key combo to an action. Only list the bindings you want to change; everything else keeps its default. Key syntax: a lowercase trigger (e.g. q, 0, escape, arrowleft) optionally prefixed with meta-, shift-, alt-, ctrl- joined by - (e.g. meta-shift-0). See docs/keymap.md.

name.description: Workspace name shown in the UI.

connections.description: Database connections belonging to this workspace.

name.description: Connection name shown in the UI.

color.description: Accent color (CSS color string) used to mark this connection in the UI.

url.description: Database connection URL, e.g. postgres://user:pass@host:5432/dbname or mysql://...

ssh_tunnel.description: Optional SSH tunnel used to reach the database through a bastion host.

ssh_user.description: SSH username on the bastion host.

key_path.description: Absolute path to the SSH private key file (e.g. a .pem).

ssh_port.description: SSH port on the bastion host.

local_port.description: Local port the tunnel binds to. Set to 0 to let the OS pick a free port.
